m01_source.query: SELECT COUNT(*) rows_total, SUM(talent_id<collaborator_talent_id) canonical_rows, SUM(talent_id=collaborator_talent_id) self_loops, SUM(co_project_count IS NULL) co_project_null, SUM(co_paper_count IS NOT NULL) co_paper_present, SUM(co_patent_count IS NOT NULL) co_patent_present FROM ads_talent_collaborator

m03_exclusion.query: SELECT COUNT(*) rows_total, SUM(i.institution_type_id='company') company_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT c.institution_id) institution_count, SUM(i.institution_id IS NULL) missing_profile_rows, SUM(t.talent_id IS NULL) missing_talent_rows FROM ads_talent_institution_cooperation c LEFT JOIN ads_institution_profile i ON c.institution_id=i.institution_id LEFT JOIN ads_talent_profile t ON c.talent_id=t.talent_id

m04_work.query: SELECT COUNT(*) rows_total, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(e.talent_id,'|',e.institution_id)) pairs_before_company, SUM(i.institution_type_id='company') company_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.institution_type_id='company' THEN CONCAT(e.talent_id,'|',e.institution_id) END) company_pairs, SUM(e.is_current IS NOT NULL) source_current_nonnull FROM ads_talent_experience e LEFT JOIN ads_institution_profile i ON e.institution_id=i.institution_id WHERE e.experience_type=2

research_types.query: SELECT institution_type_id, COUNT(*) rows_total FROM ads_institution_profile GROUP BY institution_type_id ORDER BY institution_type_id
